limitations: Six original images were opened: four new C5 candidates and two original references. No crops, image processing, programs, tests, builds, runtime probes, SSH, hashes, SQL or automatic validation were run.
Only assigned frozen case/state/metadata/action/log evidence was read. No current production source or unrelated candidate report was used to infer these verdicts.
Observed geometry is visual inspection corroborated by supplied native card coordinates, not independent pixel measurement or touch-target qualification.

Owner-reported mechanical passes were not independently executed. Desktop rotation metadata, including a possible 270-degree state elsewhere, cannot prove native framebuffer/evdev mapping, physical rotation, e-ink effects, timing or the independent live-reader lease.
This is a bounded static visual verdict for four cases only. It does not establish a full capture suite, a clean round or record review authorization.
